title: Fix/resolve bug with source description scoped operation path

raw.title: Fix/resolve bug with source description scoped operation path
raw.body:
This PR includes a minor patch relating to `sourceDescription`-scoped operationPath resolution in the `arazzo-runner`.

Previously, an `operationPath` field in an Arazzo Description of the form: `{$sourceDescriptions.petstoreDescription.url}#/paths/~1pet~1findByStatus/get`, which is valid in the Arazzo Standard (see [here](https://spec.openapis.org/arazzo/v1.0.1.html#arazzo-specification-object-example)), would get resolved to the path `//pet/findByStatus`.

This would throw an error, and cause the workflow execution to fail.

With this patch, the paths of this form are now correctly resolved.
